name: Local Data 18
definition: Contains text fields in the local language.

Language.name: Language
Language.definition: The language code conforming to ISO 639-1 that identifies the language in which the fields are expressed in this component.

EncodingFormat.name: Encoding Format
EncodingFormat.definition: Data encoding format for local data.

LegalCorporateName.name: Legal Corporate Name
LegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the party in local language

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
